=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 3 July 2020. The Facebook photo viewer names Paul Hegyi. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 18 FL on the Decipher Squadron roster (Sacramento, Ca). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/paulhegyi and lists From Sacramento, California, with a later home in San Diego. The uncropped original is Hegyi alone on a boat; a sliver of an unlabeled person sits far right of the windshield, outside the lead crop. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Paul Hegyi portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Paul Hegyi Facebook portrait.jpg]].
